content.text: {"route":"gap","reason":"The record has material gaps. For the EPA claims (10, 11) the agency conceded a prima facie case, then accepted a \"factor other than sex\" defense on thin support. No pay-setting documents, such as starting salary, pay-band placement history, or how and when each comparator reached the top of the band, appear in the record. Complainant's evidence is unaddressed: CW3, paid more, was never analyzed, and her 17 years of service and prior senior roles go unreconciled with the \"time in service\" rationale. The CW1 rationale (back-fill at full performance level) does not explain why CW1 was paid more before or apart from the back-fill. The record does not show that anyone was asked about the pay-setting decisions, such as an HR or compensation official. For the disparate treatment and harassment claims, the record relies on the supervisors' own explanations. It has no independent witnesses and no performance documentation, such as work samples, the PR error data, or the rating criteria. It has no comparative rating or PDA data beyond CW2's. The CW2 PDA comparison and the claim that CW2 was never told his job was \"too easy\" (claim 9) are not examined. The agency's decision also does not appear to analyze claims 1-9 as discrete actions, only as hostile environment, so the record cannot readily support evaluation of the conclusion."}
